name: ihudak-plugins
description: Ivan Gudak's private Claude Code plugin marketplace — productivity and workflow tools

plugins.name: dev-workflows
plugins.description: Twenty-one slash commands — /implement, /document, /docs-profile, /epics, /release-notes, /vuln, /upgrade, /api-guideline-reviewer, /guideline-reviewer, /idea, /create-vi, /create-ard, /specify, /design, /feedback, /prompt, /prompt-brainstorm, /prompt-grill-me, /statusline, /ready, and /update-vi — with Opus-backed planning, code review, product-docs review, Epic review, and engineering-design review. /document (Jira mode) preflight-discovers the docs repo + profile (in-repo → built-in dynatrace-docs default → on-demand /docs-profile) and the VI's specs dir under /workspace; Phase 4.5 determines/confirms applicable space(s); optional saas|managed constraint scopes the run to one space. A space-constrained run can additionally ground on the other space's existing docs (counterpart-finder, read-only) via auto-discovery or an explicit --counterpart <JiraID|PR-url>. /release-notes routes each note to its destination (breaking-changes / feature-updates / fixes), shapes the Summary per destination, and sources the {{#context}} label from the imported VI. Thirty-two reusable subagents (risk-planner, code-review, doc-reviewer, epic-reviewer, test-baseliner, test-writer, review-fixer, doc-fixer, docs-style-checker, doc-planner, doc-location-finder, counterpart-finder, jira-reader, idea-reader, release-notes-writer, diff-summarizer, code-scanner, impl-maintenance, guideline-reviewer, api-guideline-reviewer, upgrade-planner, upgrade-executor, vuln-research, vuln-fixer, doc-writer, epic-writer, spec-reviewer, design-reviewer, vi-reviewer, ard-reviewer, readiness-reviewer, docs-grounder) and four hooks (notifications, context injection, and a dynatrace-docs frontmatter reminder). Phase 0 toolchain preflight + gate ledger: every verification gate records an outcome the orchestrator cannot fake, and a run started without the required tooling stops before writing. /document (Jira mode) now proposes deprecation/announcement pages via a profiled announcement_pages block, writes rendered pages with no source provenance (traceability lives in the commit and run handoff), reviews callout scope and sibling component-pattern reuse, folds new-and-stale screenshot handling into one always-running image phase, and defers Phase 8's CLAUDE.md/knowledge-base maintenance edits to an apply step that runs only after the docs commit is sealed. Every run now maintains the specs repo itself: a Phase 0 preflight flushes leftover artifacts, retries an unpushed artifact commit, and settles the branch, and a terminal commit-artifacts step commits and pushes the run's feedback, cost, follow-ups, and resume pointer — bounded to $SPECS_PATH's artifact paths and to plugin-created branches, always via git -C, never force-pushing, and never failing the run.

plugins.name: dt-style-guide
plugins.description: Dynatrace corporate style guide checker and writing-aid plugin. Enforces terminology, trademarks, voice/tone, grammar, formatting, and inclusive-language rules from styleguide.dynatrace.com. Includes /dt-review-pr (review PR doc changes), /dt-review-docs (review files/directories with optional --fix), /dt-style-refresh (update vendored rules), a dt-style-checker agent, a dt-doc-fixer agent, a dt-style-rules skill, and vendored reference docs. Acts as a fallback for dev-workflows when no repo-configured prose linter is available.

plugins.name: obsidian-llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM Wiki pattern for an active Obsidian vault. Ten slash commands (/wiki-init, /wiki-ingest, /wiki-scan, /wiki-query, /wiki-save, /wiki-lint, /wiki-hot, /wiki-tags-refresh, /wiki-task, /wiki-tasks-extract) compile knowledge from meetings, projects, daily notes, and raw sources into a persistent, cross-referenced wiki at wiki/, with integrated task management via Obsidian Tasks. Supports Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as first-class agents with session-continuity hooks.

plugins.name: acli
plugins.description: Atlassian CLI (acli) reference skill for Jira and Confluence: JQL search, work items, comments, links, attachments, watchers, projects, sprints, boards, filters, and Confluence spaces, pages and blog posts. Adds container-friendly authentication (token on stdin; --web OAuth cannot complete without a browser) and a destructive-operation policy that forbids the agent from adding --yes and requires a blast-radius count before any --jql/--filter mutation. Requires the acli binary on PATH.
